newsitem.title: USA: US spot MTBE tracks gasoline upward, mostly.
newsitem.headline: US spot MTBE tracks gasoline upward, mostly.

text.p: Spot MTBE prices moved higher in the past week tracking gasoline, though it did lag gasoline's gains in a sign of just how unsexy the gasoline additive has been recently, players said Thursday.
"I'd say it's tracking gasoline 75 percent," said one trader who noted blending economics are actually attractive on a number of fronts notwithstanding it lag behind gasoline.

"General apathy toward MTBE is stopping it from coming out its doldrums, the trader said, noting MTBE is currently an attractive play for making premium gasoline as well as federally-and-California-mandated reformulated gasoline (RFG).
Barrels for April delivery in Houston were heard done on Wednesday at 82.25 and 82.50 cents a gallon, up nearly four cents from week-ago levels. Prompt MTBE was a touch weaker.
New York Harbor barrels were up by about 4.00 cents as the the spread remained unchanged at 3.00 to 3.25 over Houston.
-- Oliver Ludwig New York Energy Desk +1 212 859 1633
